overview: Disk Scheduling me head ki movement (total seek distance/time) compute karni hoti hai FCFS, SSTF, SCAN, C-SCAN, LOOK, C-LOOK ke liye; plus algorithm properties aur disk access time formula.
coreConcept: Disk head ek cylinder se doosre tak jaata hai; seek time = cylinders cross kiye x time per cylinder. Algorithm decide karta hai pending requests me se agla kaunsa service ho.
hinglishExplanation: Lift (elevator) socho: FCFS = jo pehle bola usi order me jao. SSTF = sabse paas wali manzil pehle. SCAN/LOOK = ek direction me chalte hue raaste ki saari requests nipatao, phir ulta ghoomo. C-SCAN/C-LOOK = ek hi direction me service, end par wapas shuru (circular).
formalDefinition: Total head movement = sum of |position_i - position_{i+1}| along the servicing order (including any jump-back for circular variants, depending on question).
importantProperties: FCFS: fair, par zyada seek. SSTF: seek kam, par starvation possible.
SCAN: end tak jaata hai; LOOK: last request tak hi jaata hai (end tak nahi).
C-SCAN/C-LOOK: sirf ek direction me serve karta hai, wapasi ka jump alag count hota hai (question padho ki count karna hai ya nahi).
SSTF me head ek direction me chalta reh sakta hai; direction change tabhi hota hai jab ek side ki requests khatam ho.
Disk access time = seek time + rotational latency (average = half rotation) + transfer time.
Best throughput ke liye nearest-cylinder-next (SSTF) achha hai.

formulas.headMovement: sum of absolute differences between consecutive serviced cylinders
formulas.transferTime: (1/sectors per track) x rotation time per sector read

keyPropertiesAndIdentities: SCAN vs LOOK me fark end-of-disk tak jaane ka hai; LOOK me sirf last request tak.
commonPitfalls: SCAN me disk ke end (0 ya max) tak jaana bhool jaana.
C-LOOK ka return jump count karna ya na karna — question ke hisaab se.
Time = distance x per-cylinder time, unit conversion.
standardTechniques: Requests ko sorted list me rakho, head position mark karo.
Servicing order likho, phir consecutive differences jodo.
SSTF: har step par current position se nearest unserviced request.
